name: Caltanissetta (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Caltanissetta (a yellow castle and a sword on red), with the inscription CITTÀ DI CALTANISSETTA in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Caltanissetta, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 13 January 1941.
